title: FsMount
description: Mount the owner's shared folder: a prefix of the platform's object-store bucket (Backblaze B2, or a RustFS / MinIO), reached with the owner's key, which is limited to that prefix (shared-folder design). Sent on the live link only to a daemon whose hello has fs_s3_mount: after the welcome when the owner has a ready folder, and again when the folder or its key change (generation grows: a new key, e.g. one that cannot write while the folder is over its capacity). Unreliable and never logged or stored: it carries the owner's secret key. The daemon mounts bucket:prefix with the client named in client.tool at <data dir>/mnt/<name> and answers with fs.status; a generation older than the one mounted is ignored.

name.description: The owner's folder name (atu-<16 hex>): the mount directory, and what fs.status and fs.unmount name.

prefix.description: The owner's folder in the bucket (users/<16 hex>/); the key reaches nothing outside it.

generation.description: Grows whenever the owner's key changes (provisioned again, switched to or from read-only); a remount is due when it or the name differs from the mounted one.

region.description: Region to sign requests for; default us-east-1.

client.description: The S3 mount client to run (tool): the daemon picks the asset of its platform (linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64…), downloads it and checks sha256, unless that exact version is already present.
